window-1.title: Internet Artifacts
window-1.blurb: It's a scrollable museum of the early internet where you can actually poke the floppy disks and ICQ pings — pure Y2K-nostalgia raw material for your next persona shoot.

window-2.title: Web Curios
window-2.blurb: It's one guy, every week, dragging back armfuls of the weirdest and most wonderful things on the internet with running commentary that's funnier than it has any right to be — pure side-quest fuel for you.

window-3.title: Doctor Pepo's Tonic (Zero-Proof)
window-3.blurb: This one's got apothecary energy — a little spice, a little bitterness, a name fully committed to the bit — and it's exactly the kind of drink worth building a whole evening persona around.

window-4.title: Freunde von Freunden — Home Visits
window-4.blurb: It's the nosy-friend archive of creatives' actual apartments — unstyled shelves, thrifted lamps, projects mid-sprawl — and it'll convince you that a room full of your own side-quest evidence beats any showroom.

window-5.title: MOZmoji 陌迹, Chinatown
window-5.blurb: You climb a staircase off Temple Street into a shophouse ceramics gallery where you get to pick your own handmade cup — each one modelled after a season or festival in the Chinese calendar — and then just sit there with cotton cheesecake and black sesame coffee like you live there.
